timing.note: Moved by the 2D physics world (Rapier) in fixed 4 ms steps of virtual time.

analog.note: Top-down 2D rigid body: each wheel pushes with the motor's surface speed, limited by tyre grip (Coulomb friction); sideways slip is resisted the same way; the caster adds rolling drag. No suspension, weight transfer, uneven floor or wheel slip on acceleration beyond the grip limit.

emulates: Collisions with arena walls and obstacles
doesNotEmulate: Motor load from the wheels (motors spin at their free speed; a blocked robot does not stall its motors)
testOnRealDevice: Straight-line drift (motors differ, add a trim)
Whether the sensor sees low obstacles below its mount height
